verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an official JavaScript SDK for collecting website events, extensible via plugins. Its docs include an event-spec section and an HTTP API for sending events, and it markets instrumenting one SDK to send standardized data to many destinations. Mobile and server SDKs are not evidenced, and the track/identify/page calls are never named explicitly. Missing for 10: evidence of official mobile SDKs, evidence of official server-side SDKs, explicit documentation of track/identify/page in the tracking spec, hands-on corroboration of multi-platform collection.
